_comment: Words that are valid in the current North American tournament list (NWL2023)
but absent from ENABLE. Merged into data/lexicon.js by tools/build_data.py.
This is a small factual patch, not an import of a copyrighted list: it is the
eleven two-letter words ENABLE lacks, plus the plural forms of those eleven.
The ENABLE list itself remains the lexicon. Every entry cites where it was
checked. See PROVENANCE.md for the reasoning and for what is still missing.

twos.name: Mike Wolfberg, NWL2023 two-letter words with definitions
twos.check: Page states 107 two-letter words; ENABLE has 96; the difference is exactly the eleven below.

threes.name: Mike Baron & Seth Lipkin, NWL23 Cheat Sheet (cross-tables.com)
threes.check: Each plural below was found in the sheet's three-letter list. OIS, OKS and EWS were looked for and are NOT there, so they are not added.

deliberately_not_added.ois: not in the NWL23 cheat sheet's three-letter list
deliberately_not_added.oks: not in the NWL23 cheat sheet's three-letter list
deliberately_not_added.ews: not in the NWL23 cheat sheet's three-letter list
deliberately_not_added._note: These stay in the AMBIGUOUS set in js/quiz.js instead, so they are never shown as decoys.
